subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing & Net-90 exception for ZephyrAI (Deal D-2026-0897)
messages:
From: Rebecca Chen <r.chen@zephyrai.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 request for Redwood subscription

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the performance numbers. Procurement asked me to reach out with a billing request before we execute the order. Their requirements: 1) Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter) and 2) Net-90 payment terms from invoice date.

They've attached the PO (Zephyr_PO_2026.pdf) and a short procurement form. Zephyr is a Series B company with aggressive procurement cycles; quarterly invoices simplify their AP workflow. Can Redwood accommodate Net-90 for this initial annual commitment?

If there are any governance steps or approval forms you need from us, let me know. We are targeting a start date of June 1st.

Best,
Rebecca Chen
Director, Procurement | ZephyrAI

--
Attachment: Zephyr_PO_2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, r.chen@zephyrai.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 request for Redwood subscription

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Zephyr's request. Key facts: annual committed ACV $520k, first-year ramp, wants quarterly invoices + Net-90. Procurement attached PO.

Impact & risks: 
- Cash flow: collection pushed ~60 extra days vs our standard Net-30.
- Credit: Zephyr is Series B; limited public financials. I ran a light credit check (attached spreadsheet) — red flags are modest (burn runway indicators) but nothing catastrophic.
- Contract: legal (Dev) flagged that Net-90 triggers finance approval + exec sign-off per policy for terms >60 days.

Recommended mitigations if we approve: 
- Add a 1.5% late-fee / finance-hold clause after 90 days, or a 2% processing fee for Net-90.
- Require PO + signed SOW before provisioning.
- Add shorter SLA penalty caps tied to invoicing cadence.

Request: Vivek/Laura — need exec sign-off to proceed with non-standard terms. If approved, I'll confirm to Rebecca and circulate contract redlines.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Zephyr_credit_request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 request for Redwood subscription

Hi team,

Finance review: policy requires CFO / revenue ops approval for payment terms greater than Net-60 for deals > $250k ACV. This deal is $520k ACV so it triggers an exception path.

Considerations: 
- Collection risk for Net-90 materially increases DSO; we would prefer Net-60 or a milestone-based schedule tied to quarterly billing.
- If sales insists on Net-90, require: (a) signed PO + SOW before provisioning, (b) a 2% processing fee, and (c) credit guardrail: if payment is >60 days late on any invoice, suspend provisioning until remediation and require partial prepayment for remaining invoices.

Please document the requested exception and route to Vivek (Sales Leader) and CFO (cc'd offline) for approval. Vivek — can you provide quick leadership sign-off or propose an alternative compromise?

-Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 request for Redwood subscription

Laura / Rafael — I reviewed the deal context and value. Zephyr is strategic in the enterprise ML vertical; landing this account accelerates our regional go-to-market. I approve proceeding with an exception under the following hard conditions: 

1) Zephyr signs the PO + SOW and acknowledges the credit terms in writing.
2) We include a 2% processing fee on Net-90 invoices (to be itemized).
3) Add a clause: any invoice >60 days overdue triggers suspension of service until cured and requires a 25% prepay for the next billing cycle.
4) Legal to add standard audit and data-protection assurances; no other commercial concessions.

Rafael — if you can get Rebecca to accept those terms, finance can greenlight. Dev, please prepare redlines reflecting the processing fee and suspension clause. Laura, note this as approved by Sales leadership; CFO can sign off operationally if no other concerns.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Chen <r.chen@zephyrai.com>, procurement@zephyrai.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 May 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 request for Redwood subscription

Hi Rebecca — thanks for the PO and patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: Sales leadership has approved a Net-90 / quarterly invoicing exception for Zephyr under the following conditions (please confirm acceptance in writing so we can finalize SOW):

- Quarterly invoicing as requested; payments due 90 days from invoice date.
- 2% processing fee applied to invoices under Net-90 terms (itemized).
- If any invoice becomes >60 days overdue, Redwood reserves the right to suspend provisioning until payment is cured; a 25% prepayment will be required for the next invoice cycle.
- Signed PO + SOW required before provisioning and billing.

If you accept, I will have Legal issue a redlined SOW and Finance will process the invoicing schedule. We can target a June 1st start if paperwork is returned by next Wednesday (5/21).

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
